notes: Tell Mossad to do things: add a point for a meeting, add a task, bookmark a moment, with a receipt and Undo. Your AI apps can read everything in the app: people, recurring meetings, your points, the coach, and more.

More room to read on every page, with one spacing scale for the whole app. Pages use a wide window well: a full-width top and centered content. A transcript no longer drops a line beside two bookmarks.

A quick chat panel over any app, with a shortcut you can change. Your points during the call, checked off as you raise them. Recurring meetings by weekday, and on a calendar. The list shows your next two work days. A headset that changes mode can no longer stop a recording.
More room in chat answers and questions.

Ask the call you are on: a chat with the live call, with quick questions. A new chat design with times that open the moment. More accurate names in the live transcript. A finding's audio stops when you answer the card.
Back and Forward in the main window. Recurring is first under Meetings, with search and a filter. 45 days of upcoming meetings, by day. Anonymous usage statistics, with a switch in Settings.
